final: WITH grp AS (SELECT e.ID AS pid, p.SEX AS sex, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS grp_avg FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY e.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(grp_avg) AS overall_avg FROM grp), diffs AS (SELECT g.pid, g.sex, g.grp_avg, g.grp_avg - o.overall_avg AS diff FROM grp g JOIN overall o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), sex_avg AS (SELECT sex, AVG(diff) AS sex_diff_avg FROM diffs GROUP BY sex) SELECT d.pid, d.sex, d.grp_avg, d.diff, d.diff - s.sex_diff_avg AS dev FROM diffs d JOIN sex_avg s ON d.sex = s.sex WHERE d.diff > s.sex_diff_avg ORDER BY (d.diff - s.sex_diff_avg) IS NULL, (d.diff - s.sex_diff_avg) DESC LIMIT 10
